_comment: Chunk-level retrieval probes for the gating experiment.
Note-level ground truth cannot measure chunking: with one note per subject the
right note is always rank 1 and every configuration ties. These probes ask for a
specific fact that lives INSIDE a multi-chunk note, so the question is whether the
chunk carrying the answer ranks highly among that note's own sibling chunks.
Gold is an answer SPAN, not a chunk id, because chunk boundaries differ per
configuration — a retrieved chunk counts as correct when it contains the span.
type: fact       — answer sits in one block
hierarchy  — answer only makes sense together with its parent heading
note: the note the span lives in (all are multi-chunk)
